net_stance.campuspulse: within each parent, normalize its 10 particle weights; weighted mean(support)-weighted mean(opposition)
net_stance.generative_agents: five-level full-population questionnaire response divided by 2

operators.mean: unweighted arithmetic mean of the 1000 parent-agent stances
operators.sarle_bimodality: (bias-corrected skewness^2+1)/bias-corrected Pearson kurtosis; NA if n<4, variance<1e-10, or kurtosis<=0
operators.kde_peaks: Gaussian KDE with scipy Scott bandwidth on 1024 equally spaced points over [-1,1]; scipy find_peaks prominence=5% of maximum density; NA if n<3 or variance<1e-10
operators.interest_group_r_squared: one-dimensional between-group sum of squares divided by total sum of squares on net stance; NA when stance variance is below 1e-10
operators.permutation_test: 199 label permutations; one-sided add-one empirical p=(1+number(permuted_R2>=observed_R2))/200; RNG seed=20260722+tick
operators.entropy: natural-log Shannon entropy over fixed bins [-1,-0.6,-0.2,0.2,0.6,1]; normalized value divides by ln(5)

interpretation_boundary: The 12-dimensional multivariate interest-group R-squared belongs to the dimension-three ablation panel and must not be inserted into this cross-method net-stance table.
